The prime case gathers the named Datta anchors and direct companions. The other western contexts and Brahma Kumaris retain separate cohort labels.

tradeoffs: The core Kriya family now shares Vitrine 5: Babaji, Lahiri, Yukteswar, Yogananda and the named companions, including Keshavanandji and both Ramaiah records. Its 3.04 recorded shelf shares remain an occupancy comparison, not confirmed physical fit.
Vitrine 2 brings the early Gaudiya anchors together. Mirabai–Ravidas–Tulsidas–Kabir remains a deliberate sequence of distinct stories; it is not a model for splitting a hierarchical family.
Vitrine 3 now includes Narasimha Saraswati and the Akkalkot immediate group with Dattatreya and Tembe. The Brahma Kumaris remain together at 81, with other western cohorts separately labelled.

Cases 1, 3 and 45 retain a small amount of broader regional infill where clearing it would exceed the neighboring comparison reference. The BAPS, Datta and Varkari main stories remain distinct from that infill. Cases 2, 4, 5 and 57 prioritize their named anchors and close groups.
Veerabrahmendra and Siddhaiah greet the visitor at 74. Guntur Ram Nam stays together at 21; Yerriswamy joins the Karnataka neighborhood at 72.
Radha Raman moves with the existing case-8 group to 7, beside Banke Bihari in 6; the former case-7 grouping moves intact to 8. Hanuman joins Tulsidas at 36.

Exact canonical merges remain separate from co-location. Ramaiah is confirmed as one person, but both source observations are preserved until the merge workflow can preserve every affected store. Hatiram/Hathiram and Nar Hari remain identity holds.
